title: If `onReviewPublished` fails after the review is public, the `reviewPublished` catch rethrows before `sweepMet
text: If `onReviewPublished` fails after the review is public, the `reviewPublished` catch rethrows before `sweepMetadata()` logs the established classification. This loses the required logs-only per-category record for a post-publication persistence/recovery failure. Emit the record before this callback (or in the `reviewPublished` failure path) and cover it.
rationale: Checked against head 8310b84: src/core/run-review-pass.ts calls sweepMetadata(), which calls logSweepPassRecord(), before deps.onReviewPublished runs, so a failure in that callback does not lose the logs-only record. The finding was wrong on the recorded head. Corrected from true_positive after a Codex comment on #138. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
